name: ctx-guard
description: Configurable context and usage guard: per-role notes, tool blocks, guarded handoff with clear-and-resume or compact, and subagent context budgets.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn ctx-guard on. false makes it do nothing in every project, whatever the project config says.

configPath.title: Config file
configPath.description: Project config file, relative to the project root. A .local.json file beside it overrides it for you alone.

defaultRole.title: Default role
defaultRole.description: Role for an interactive session when no command, CTX_GUARD_ROLE or project defaultRole sets one. Empty for none.

blocking.title: Block tools
blocking.description: Let triggers deny tool calls. false keeps notes and toasts and lifts every deny.

autoActions.title: Automatic actions
autoActions.description: Let ctx-guard run /clear with a resume, /compact, a keep-warm ping or a handoff prompt, when every guard holds. false keeps the notes and leaves these to you.

noteToasts.title: Toast on notes
noteToasts.description: Show a toast each time ctx-guard sends the model a note: its level, the figure and what the model was asked. false leaves notes unseen.

display.title: Display
display.description: band: a line above the prompt where the surface has one, else status-line text. status: status-line text only. off: nothing drawn.
